discussion_comments.comment_body: Bounded the retry-enabled pre-content probe so it stops buffering after a fixed number of non-content events and hands the stream back to the handler. This preserves the pre-content retry window while avoiding unbounded buffering or response delay. Added regression coverage for the bound.

Good catch — addressed in 21825bc4. Hoisted all inline regexes in this file to package level: the 4 duration patterns (now `opencodeGoDurationUnits`) plus the two in `cleanOpenCodeGoResetText` / `cleanOpenCodeGoHTMLText`, matching the existing package-level patterns.
已调整：`modelAssociationSignature` 不再在请求热路径上对完整 association slice 做 `json.Marshal`，改为字段级 FNV 签名。这个实现覆盖当前 `ModelAssociation` 的所有可影响路由的字段，并补了嵌套 condition 变化会改变签名的回归测试。
